description: Electron clipboard shelf that lives on the left edge of your screen.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path "$dir\Edge-Drop.exe" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Edge-Drop.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\resources\app.asar" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\app.asar was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\resources\startup\EdgeDropStartup.exe" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\startup\EdgeDropStartup.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
